verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a per-endpoint REST API reference (Sale, Checkout, Get Decision, webhooks) and a markdown version of the docs. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console or executable request samples. A static reference is adjacent to this story and does not satisfy it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
